    Exactness of the second sequence of Proposition 2.6(1) #

    graded-category.tex: "Applying these arguments to the opposite module category proves exactness of the second sequence in (1)." In (mod A)ᵒᵖ the right radical approximations are the left meshes of mod A (biproducts of the left almost split maps of the summands, with I → I/soc I at injective summands), and the Krull–Schmidt normal form is the target normal form of mod A; so the abstract Lemma 2.5 holds in (mod A)ᵒᵖ.

    At a nonprojective vertex x the almost split sequence τx → E_x → x is also the left mesh of τx. Its dual radical approximation gives, for a family v_i : E_i → W out of the summands:

    • (lowest degree) ∑ α_i v_i ∈ J² implies every v_i ∈ J;
    • (exactness at the middle) if every v_i ∈ J^{n+1} and ∑ α_i v_i ∈ J^{n+3}, then v_i ≡ β_i u modulo J^{n+2} for one u ∈ J^n(x, W);
    • (injectivity) if every β_i u ∈ J^{n+2}, then u ∈ J^{n+1}.
